column3: Recommending films by low-rank matrix completion: ALS versus singular value thresholding
column4: Name Surname, Name Surname, Name Surname
column8: Input: a sparse table of user ratings of films. Output: predicted ratings for unseen films, used to recommend them. Good predictions from very few ratings are what makes recommenders useful.
column9: MovieLens 100K (https://grouplens.org/datasets/movielens/100k/): 100,000 ratings from 943 users on 1,682 films. Downloaded and loaded.
column10: The central object is the 943 x 1682 ratings matrix, whose entries are the known ratings (about 6% observed); we need to approximate it by a matrix of low rank that matches the observed entries.
column11: 1) Alternating least squares: fix one factor, solve a least-squares problem for the other. We implement it fully. 2) Singular value thresholding: repeated truncated SVD. We implement the iteration and call a library SVD.
column12: Lab 4 covers SVD compression of complete matrices; we work with incomplete ones and compare two algorithms. Not LLM-related.
